name: parcelpilot-firebase
description: Firebase project config, security rules tests and emulator scripts for ParcelPilot.

scripts.test:rules: ./scripts-env.sh firebase emulators:exec --project demo-parcelpilot --only firestore,storage "vitest run --dir tests"
scripts.test:functions:integration: ./scripts-env.sh firebase emulators:exec --project demo-parcelpilot --only firestore,auth "npm --prefix functions run test:integration"
